ic_name: TIA/EIA-485 (RS-485 via TI SLLA272C Design Guide)

bring_up_sequence.description: K28.5               COMMA code group for symbol alignment
D0.0 - D31.7,       Link Number within component
D0.0 - D31.0,       Lane Number within Port
– 255               D0.0 - D31.7        N_FTS. This is the number of fast training
Bit 0 = 0, 1          D0.0, D1.0, D2.0,   Link Control

test_cases_present: partial - the spec is electrical-only and describes conformance points (driver / receiver minimums, common-mode range, termination, stub length, failsafe) but does not provide a formal testbench.
derived_compliance_test_categories: Reset behavior: enable bit cleared; transmit-empty flag set; receive-flag cleared after reset.
Master mode transmission: write to data register + clock-cycle delay + N edges + receive-flag set.
Slave mode transmission: select line goes LOW + N edges from master + receive-flag set after last edge.
